description: Eval set for supervisor routing decisions. Each ticket has the raw customer message, the expected worker agent, and a note on why (useful for debugging misroutes). 'requires_approval' flags tickets whose resolution should trigger the human-in-the-loop interrupt.

tickets.query: I was charged twice for my subscription this month, can you check?
tickets.note: Clear billing intent, needs invoice lookup

tickets.query: Please cancel my subscription and refund the last payment, I don't want to keep talking about it.
tickets.note: Refund + cancellation = risky action, should pause for approval

tickets.query: The app crashes every time I try to upload a PDF larger than 5MB.
tickets.note: Straightforward bug report

tickets.query: I've emailed support three times this week and no one has replied. This is unacceptable.
tickets.note: Frustration + repeated contact = escalation signal, not a new technical/billing issue

tickets.query: My invoice shows a $50 charge I don't recognize AND the dashboard won't load at all.
tickets.note: Multi-intent ticket: billing question is the primary ask; test whether supervisor splits into two tasks or picks one. Good one to log disagreement on.

tickets.query: Can you delete my account and all my data permanently?
tickets.note: Destructive action, must require human approval even though routed to technical

tickets.query: How do I export my data to CSV?
tickets.note: Simple how-to, no risky action

tickets.query: Your product is a scam and I want my money back NOW or I'm reporting you.
tickets.note: Tone signals escalation even though 'money back' sounds like billing; refund still needs approval once resolved

tickets.query: What plans do you offer for teams of 10+?
tickets.note: Pricing/plan question, no account-specific action

tickets.query: I think there's a bug but I'm not sure — sometimes my saved filters just disappear.
tickets.note: Vague/uncertain phrasing, tests robustness to hedging language

tickets.query: This is the second time my payment failed even though my card is valid. Fix this or I'm switching providers.
tickets.note: Threat of churn but core issue is still billing/payment — tests over-triggering escalation on tone alone

tickets.query: Can I speak to a manager about how my last ticket was handled?
tickets.note: Explicit escalation request

tickets.query: asdkfj my thing broke pls help
tickets.note: Low-quality/garbled input, tests graceful handling of noisy text

tickets.query: Please issue a full refund for the annual plan I bought yesterday by mistake.
tickets.note: Clear refund request, must trigger approval interrupt

tickets.query: Is there an API rate limit? I'm getting 429 errors intermittently.
tickets.note: Developer-facing technical question

tickets.query: I was quoted one price on the phone and charged a different amount online.
tickets.note: Discrepancy investigation, no action taken yet so no approval needed until resolution decided

tickets.query: You people never fix anything. I've had 5 tickets open for a month.
tickets.note: Pattern-of-neglect complaint, not a single new issue

tickets.query: Does your platform support SSO with Okta?
tickets.note: Pre-sales technical question, tests boundary between technical and billing/sales

tickets.query: Charge me for the upgrade and also delete my old workspace, both today please.
tickets.note: Two actions across two domains (billing charge + destructive delete); good stress test for single-agent routing vs multi-step plan

tickets.query: thanks for the quick fix yesterday, just confirming it's still working fine
tickets.note: Not actually a problem — tests false-positive routing on a closed/positive message

tickets.query: I want to downgrade my plan starting next billing cycle.
tickets.note: Future-dated plan change, not immediately destructive, arguably no approval needed — good disagreement case to discuss

tickets.query: Legal here — we need all account activity logs for a compliance audit by Friday.
tickets.note: Legal/compliance request, high-stakes and time-boxed, should never be auto-resolved by a worker agent

tickets.query: The mobile app keeps logging me out every 5 minutes on iOS 18.
tickets.note: Platform-specific bug report

tickets.query: I paid for premium but I'm still seeing ads.
tickets.note: Looks technical (ads showing) but root cause is billing/entitlement mismatch — classic misroute trap

tickets.query: hi
tickets.note: No actual content — tests fallback/default behavior when intent is empty. Consider a 'clarify' path rather than forcing a category.
